evals.prompt: whats open on github right now, anything worth doing this week?
evals.expected_output: Triggers the skill, fetches open issues via gh, categorizes and prioritizes them, writes/updates docs/issue-plans/TRIAGE.md, then asks the user which issue(s) to write a full plan for rather than planning everything unattended.

evals.prompt: plan out issue 56 for me, i want to actually see the code changes
evals.expected_output: Triggers the skill scoped to issue #56, reads the issue body/comments, reads the real files it would touch, and writes docs/issue-plans/issue-56-<slug>.md with concrete code snippets grounded in the actual codebase and file:line citations. Does not touch tasks/plan.md or tasks/todo.md.

evals.prompt: go ahead and implement the plan for 56 and put up a PR
evals.expected_output: Triggers --fix behavior: requires an existing plan for issue 56, creates a branch off the default branch, implements tasks one commit at a time, runs the project's verification gates, and stops to get explicit confirmation before pushing or opening a draft PR.
